title: Invoice Status dropdown offers exactly four options with All Statuses as the default
refs: specs/sbr-sales-by-representative.md Story 4 S4-R1; S4-R2; S4-R3; S4-R5
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the report with no remembered settings.
custom_steps:
1. Find the "Invoice Status" dropdown in the toolbar and read its default value.
2. Open it and read the options.
3. Change the selection and watch the table.
custom_expected:
1. An "Invoice Status" dropdown is visible in the toolbar.
2. It offers exactly four options: "All Statuses," "Unpaid," "Partially Paid," "Paid."
3. "All Statuses" is the default on first load.
4. Changing the selection re-fetches and re-renders the report.
